summary.en: Create Student objects and follow their fields, methods and reference variables.
summary.bn: Student অবজেক্ট বানিয়ে তার ফিল্ড, মেথড আর রেফারেন্সের সম্পর্ক বোঝো।

notes: Ordinary classes, instance members and new work without newer Java features.

sections.title: Give one student a home for related data
Fields describe state, methods describe work
Separate the reference from the object
Build, compare and share Student instances
Choose a responsibility before adding members
Count objects rather than variable names
Follow each receiver to its own state

examples.title: One student result
examples.explanationHtml: The object holds roll 17 and mark 75. passed reads that mark and returns true.

examples.title: Independent students
examples.explanationHtml: The first and second variables reach separate Student objects. Their marks lead to different pass decisions.

examples.title: Two references to one student
examples.explanationHtml: Both variables reach one object. Changing its mark through second is visible through first.

examples.title: Default field values
examples.explanationHtml: The int fields start at zero. A zero mark fails the threshold check.

practice.title: Student pass decision
practice.statementHtml: Input: roll from 1 to 999 and mark from 0 to 100. Store them in Student and print roll, one space and true for a passing mark of at least 40, otherwise false.
hints: Let passed read the object mark.

practice.title: Rectangle state
practice.statementHtml: Input: width and height from 0 to 1000. Store them in Rectangle fields and print its area method result.
hints: Call the method through the room reference.

practice.title: Separate mark updates
practice.statementHtml: Input: two marks from 0 to 100. Create two Student objects. Add 5 to the first mark, capped at 100, then print both marks separated by one space.
hints: Use new twice to keep the states independent.

practice.title: Count passing students
practice.statementHtml: Input: n from 0 to 20 followed by n marks. Create one Student for each mark and count passing objects. Print the count.
hints: The array initially contains references; fill each one before calling a method.

quiz.prompt: Which mark does a Student method read for this receiver?
quiz.explanation: passed reads s.mark, and 39 is below 40.

quiz.prompt: Does new Student twice produce independent field storage?
quiz.explanation: b is a different object whose int mark still has its default zero value.

quiz.prompt: Which field value is visible after assigning an alias?
quiz.explanation: a and b refer to the same Student; the shared roll becomes 8.

quiz.prompt: What does Student s; alone create inside a method?
quiz.explanation: The declaration creates no Student object and the local must be assigned before reading.

quiz.prompt: What is the receiver of student.passed()?
quiz.explanation: An instance method executes with a particular receiver object.
An operation with parentheses describes behaviour; plain attributes describe state.

quiz.prompt: How many objects result from Student a = new Student(); Student b = a;?
quiz.explanation: Only one new expression allocates an object. Assignment copies its reference.

quiz.prompt: Which statement describes Java memory management here?
options: Reference variables contain raw C pointers
Objects are destroyed at every closing brace
Unreachable objects may be reclaimed by garbage collection
quiz.explanation: Java manages object memory. Scope exit and immediate destruction are not the same event.

quiz.prompt: What default does an int instance field receive?
quiz.explanation: Object fields receive default values; local variables have different assignment rules.

options: Every function must belong to Student
The operation uses the student mark that belongs to that object
quiz.explanation: Related state and behaviour become easier to understand together.

quiz.prompt: What does new Student[3] contain before individual Student construction?
quiz.explanation: Allocating a reference array does not construct its element objects.

keyPoints.en: Fields store the state of an object.
An instance method acts through a particular object.
keyPoints.bn: ইনস্ট্যান্স মেথড নির্দিষ্ট অবজেক্টের মাধ্যমে কাজ করে।

keyPoints.en: new creates an object and returns a reference.
keyPoints.bn: new অবজেক্ট বানিয়ে তার রেফারেন্স ফেরত দেয়।

keyPoints.en: Two Student instances can hold different marks.
keyPoints.bn: দুটি Student ইনস্ট্যান্সে আলাদা নম্বর থাকতে পারে।

keyPoints.en: Copying a reference does not copy the object.
keyPoints.bn: রেফারেন্স কপি করলে অবজেক্ট কপি হয় না।

examQuestions.question: Draw a Student UML class with roll, mark and passed, then distinguish attributes from operations.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Use a class box with Student at the top, roll: int and mark: int in the attributes compartment, and passed(): boolean in the operations compartment. Attributes hold state; operations use that state.

examQuestions.question: Trace two references after Student b = a and b.mark = 90.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Both references identify the same Student. There is one mark field, so a.mark and b.mark both read 90.

examQuestions.question: Compare a local reference declaration with new Student().
examQuestions.answerHtml: A declaration gives a variable a type and name. new constructs an object and returns its reference. A local variable must receive a value before it can be read.
